question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** Alimentery.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Here let's see the correct spelling and meaning of the given word:

__
 
• The correct spelling is ***"Alimentary"***
 
• **Alimentary -** of or relating to nourishment or nutrition
 
 
• ***Eg. ***Diarrhea in aging cats can indicate hyperthyroidism or *alimentary* lymphoma.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will have a look at the other given words with their meanings:

 
• **Alliterate -** to form an alliteration

 
 
• ***Eg.*** rocky road
 
 
 
• **Elementary-** basic 
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***I have an *elementary *knowledge of physics
 
 
 
• **illiterate​ **- unable to read and write
 
 
• ***​Eg.* **A surprising percentage of the population is* illiterate*.
